'''Palo Pevv''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a treasure hunter during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He could be frequently found in the [[Drunkard's Vote]] cantina in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Senate Commercial District]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Palo Pevv appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a skill trainer for Treasure Hunting on Coruscant.
